newsitem.title: USA: Global Village cuts Mac modem prices.
newsitem.headline: Global Village cuts Mac modem prices.

text.p: Global Village Communication Inc said on Monday it cut prices up to 24 percent on three of its fax/modem products for Apple Computer Inc's Macintosh computers.

Prices for the PowerPort Platinum and PowerPort Platinum Pro PC card 28.8/33.6 fax/modems for Macintosh Powerbook computers were reduced 24 percent, to $219 and $349, respectively, Global Village said.
The TelePort 33.6 Internet Edition external fax-modem was cut 17 percent, to an estimated street price of $149.
Global Village shares were trading down 3/64, to 1-41/64, at midday Monday. Their 52-week high was 19.
